$comment: Reviewed draft for the 7050TX-64 config-session probes (#14 §3; hw-session-probe.live.test.ts).
This file is the PR review artifact — the operator re-reads it live at the switch before
EAPI_HW_PROBE_SPEC points at it. Every batch runs inside `configure session hw-probe-<name>`;
allowCommit batches are mechanically fenced by parseHwProbeSpec to indented children of
exactly `interface {{SCRATCH}}` (the one designated unused port, from EAPI_SCRATCH_INTERFACE,
guard-checked + linkStatus-checked at run time). Nothing here touches users, the listener, the
management path, ZTP, rollback/replace, or persistence — parseHwProbeSpec refuses those lines.
SUGGESTED RUN ORDER: the abort-only batches first while the console is fresh; then
scratch-description, scratch-mtu, scratch-switchport-restore-order and scratch-restore (the
commit set) LAST, in that order, so restore undoes the committed set before the session ends.
REV 2 (2026-11-08, DR-134): (a) the first executed run died INSIDE switchport-modes when the
SKU refused `switchport trunk allowed vlan only 10,20` — EOS 4.28.13.1M answers 1002 / Invalid
input at token 'only', and it stops that staged batch right there, masking the batch's later
questions. So that batch is now three one-question batches, and the harness likewise records a
refusal and continues instead of throwing. (b) scratch-restore drops `no switchport`: the port's
pre-session state is L2-by-default (mode access after the default it carries since run 1), so a
committed `no switchport` would strand the port routed instead of net-zero.
REV 3 (2026-11-08, after run 2, DR-135): run 2 answered switchport-l2-baseline (accepted),
trunk-allowed-only (REFUSED — the SKU does not know the `only` keyword), routed-conversion
(accepted), trunk-groups (ACCEPTED: `switchport trunk group HWGRP` reached the session diff),
lacp-abort (accepted; implicit `interface Port-Channel999` appears in the diff), and
vlans-vrrp-iprouting DIED AT ITS FIRST LINE (`vlan 4090 name …` → 1002 at token 'name'), which
is DR-134's masking failure again in a batch this rev had left unsplit: the VLAN, SVI, VRRP and
ip-routing questions were never asked. That batch is now five one-question batches. The run then
crashed one statement AFTER committing scratch-description (a harness bug, fixed in the runner:
the scratch read-back used the singular `show running-config interface`, which this SKU refuses).
STATE ON THE SWITCH RIGHT NOW: Ethernet22 carries a committed `description HW-CAPTURE-PROBE`
(run 2, never restored — the restore set never ran). If the operator wants scratch-description to
show a real diff, run the restore batch ALONE first (EAPI_HW_PROBE_ONLY=scratch-restore), then the
full spec; otherwise scratch-description re-commits a no-op and the trailing restore still nets
the port clean.

batches.name: session-lifecycle
batches.question: named session + description + a no-op stage line: open/diff/abort visible in show configuration sessions (baseline orphan state too)

batches.name: switchport-l2-baseline
batches.question: DR-029 precondition on the real SKU: plain `switchport` + `switchport mode trunk` stage accepted inside a session (the trunk READ shape came from batch 1; this is the write shape)

batches.name: trunk-allowed-only
batches.question: the line that killed run 1: does the SKU CLI know the `only` keyword in `switchport trunk allowed vlan only A,B`? (the BARE spelling is already PROVEN accepted and committed by the lab corpus on this switch, 2026-11-08)

batches.name: routed-conversion
batches.question: L2 to Routed conversion inside a session on the SKU: no switchport + a /31 — accepted (then aborted), and does a non-default address stage on a front-panel port

batches.name: trunk-groups
batches.question: open item 4's OTHER half: does switchport trunk group exist on the 7050TX-64 (cEOS said yes under DR-122; SKU answer still owed)

batches.name: vlan-inline-name
batches.question: run-2 answer, now its own batch: is the one-line `vlan <id> name <name>` form SKU grammar? (it is NOT — 1002 Invalid input at token 'name', staged nothing)

batches.name: vlan-block-form
batches.question: the spelling this client's vlan resource composes: `vlan 4090` then an indented `name` child — does the block form stage on the 7050TX-64

batches.name: vlan-interface-ip
batches.question: SVI on the box: `interface Vlan4090` + an indented address — accepted while the VLAN is only session-staged (EOS may refuse a dangling SVI inside a session)

batches.name: vlan-interface-vrrp
batches.question: the question actually owed since run 1: VRRP (v2 form `vrrp <group> ip <addr>`) on an SVI on the SKU. The interface line above is the already-accepted context, per DR-134 one NEW line per batch

batches.name: ip-routing
batches.question: global `ip routing` acceptance inside a named session (abort-only — it is not scratch-scoped so parseHwProbeSpec would refuse it committed; the diff answers whether the SKU even stages it)

batches.name: lacp-abort
batches.question: implicit Port-Channel creation + mode syntax inside a session on the SKU (LACP limits themselves were a read question — and batch 1 ANSWERED it on 2026-11-08: `show lag resources` is invalid command on this unit)

batches.name: scratch-description
batches.question: commit round-trip on the designated scratch port: description set (then batch restore no-ops it)

batches.name: scratch-mtu
batches.question: does the SKU accept mtu 9214 on a front-panel port and echo it in show interfaces (features.md ceiling is 7050X-derived)

batches.name: scratch-switchport-restore-order
batches.question: L2 mode + access vlan commit cycle on the scratch port (then the restore batch re-states the defaults)

batches.name: scratch-restore
batches.question: cleanup toward the declared pre-session L2-default state (REV-2: `no switchport` DROPPED — it would strand the port routed; explicit `switchport mode auto`/`access vlan 1` re-state what a pristine default port carries implicitly, so for a byte-clean port the authorized step is the operator typing `default interface <scratch>` at the CLI console)
